title: RAG Engineer
summary: Build retrieval-augmented chatbots that answer questions from company documents.
description:
RAG Engineer

You will build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that let employees ask questions about internal documents and get grounded, cited answers.

Requirements:
- Strong Python skills
- Experience with LangChain or LlamaIndex
- Vector databases such as FAISS, Chroma or Pinecone
- Embeddings, chunking strategies and prompt engineering with LLM APIs
- Building REST APIs with FastAPI or Flask
- Git and working in a collaborative team

Nice to have:
- Docker
- Evaluating RAG quality (e.g. RAGAS)

title: Junior RAG Engineer
summary: Build retrieval-augmented LLM features and multi-agent workflows on top of our internal knowledge base.
description:
Junior RAG Engineer

We are building AI assistants that answer questions from our internal documents. You will help design the retrieval pipeline, build agent workflows, and expose them through simple web APIs.

What you will do:
- Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines in Python
- Design multi-agent workflows with LangChain and LangGraph
- Write prompts and structured outputs for LLMs such as Gemini or GPT
- Expose AI features through REST APIs (Flask or FastAPI)
- Test and debug LLM behaviour and document what you find

Requirements:
- Good Python skills
- Hands-on experience with LangChain or LangGraph
- Experience calling LLM APIs (Gemini, OpenAI or similar)
- Basic REST API development
- Git and GitHub for team projects

Nice to have:
- Embeddings and vector databases (FAISS, Chroma, pgvector)
- SQL databases
- JavaScript for simple frontends
